data.one_liner: Core abstractions and LangChain Expression Language for LangChain.dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides foundational abstractions like language models, document loaders, and vector stores for the LangChain.dart ecosystem. Includes the LangChain Expression Language (LCEL) to compose components into sequences or DAGs.
use_when: You are building a framework on top of LangChain.dart
You need to interoperate with LangChain.dart components
You want to use LCEL to compose LLM components into sequences or DAGs
avoid_when: You are looking for ready-to-use provider integrations without writing underlying framework code
You do not need LLM abstractions or component composition
strengths: Modularity with independent abstractions not tied to specific model providers
Stable versioning scheme with advance notice for breaking changes
Battle-tested design used in production environments
weaknesses: Requires careful migration for breaking changes, such as ordered content blocks in recent updates
